Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape

Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships

Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement

Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM

Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. title: Video editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel e Commerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.

What Success Looks Like Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts

Responsibilities Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and You Tube Shorts Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and Meta Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors

Requirements 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects Motion graphics and animation capabilities Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, Tik Tok, Instagram Reels) Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones

Nice to Have Experience with Cap Cut or other mobile-first editing tools Sound design and audio mixing skills Understanding of Tik Tok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects

Compensation and Benefits Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Immigration paralegal (immigration court / removal defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Read back agent - portuguese/english (immigration legal services)
description:
About Bueno Law Corp

Bueno Law Corp is a mission‑driven immigration law firm dedicated to helping survivors of domestic violence, LGBTQ+ immigrants, and other vulnerable individuals build safe, stable lives in the United States. We provide compassionate, trauma‑informed representation while maintaining the highest standards of legal excellence.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Spanish‑speaking Read Back Agent to help clients fully understand the immigration work completed on their behalf. You’ll serve as a trusted communicator—summarizing case progress, explaining filings, and ensuring clients feel informed, supported, and empowered throughout their humanitarian or asylum process.

Conduct “read back” sessions with clients in native Portuguese , summarizing legal work completed on their cases Explain filings, evidence submissions, and next steps in clear, accessible language Translate complex legal concepts into client‑friendly explanations without altering meaning Confirm client understanding and address questions with patience and care Communicate internally in English with attorneys, paralegals, and case managers Document all client interactions accurately in the case management system Uphold trauma‑informed communication practices and strict confidentiality standards

What You Bring

Native or near‑native Portuguese fluency English fluency (spoken and written) Excellent verbal communication skills High attention to detail and strong listening skills Ability to stay calm, empathetic, and professional during sensitive conversations Experience with immigrant communities or legal services preferred Comfort working in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment Basic knowledge of immigration processes (training provided)

Core Strengths

Client‑centered communication Cultural sensitivity Reliability and accuracy Professionalism and integrity Team collaboration

Why This Role Matters

You’ll help clients understand life‑changing legal work during some of the most vulnerable moments of their lives. Your communication ensures they feel safe, informed, and supported—strengthening trust and improving outcomes.

What We Offer

Competitive pay Training designed to help you succeed Paid vacation, sick leave, and birthdays off U. S. paid holidays Clear, structured growth opportunities within the firm Fully remote, full‑time position

title: Business development & marketing
description:
About i QIYI

i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Senior aml investigations & case specialist
description:
This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity. Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings. Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation. Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf. Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required. Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO. Maintain accurate records of investigations and case decisions for regulatory and audit purposes. Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment. Support regulatory examinations, audits, and ongoing enhancement of AML controls and monitoring processes.

Requirements Brazilian citizen with the legal right to work in Brazil. Must be based in Brazil 3–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime investigations, or compliance within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payment institution, or cryptocurrency exchange. Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, suspicious transaction reporting, and financial crime typologies. Experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening, and case management tools. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline compliance processes, and enhance the quality of regulatory analysis and decision-making.

Profile Strong analytical and investigative judgement with excellent attention to detail. Able to make sound, risk-based decisions independently while maintaining high standards of documentation. Collaborative, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. Passionate about cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and the evolving digital asset ecosystem, with a genuine curiosity to stay ahead of industry and regulatory developments.

title: Vendedor closer: venda técnica de alto ticket
description:
Vendedor Closer: Venda Técnica de Alto Ticket

Verde Equipamentos Pindamonhangaba, São Paulo, Brasil (Presencial)

Você sabe vender. Se você é Vendedor closer e procura um lugar onde o processo existe de verdade e o seu esforço vira resultado no holerite, continue lendo.

O que falta não é talento. Você abre o CRM, vê o pipeline, sabe quais leads estão quentes e onde cada um travou. Não começa do zero, não depende de sorte, não improvisa. Você vende dentro de um processo, e isso, pra você, não é limitação. É o que te faz ser bom.

Na Verde Equipamentos, pessoas que querem fabricar tijolos ecológicos, construir com economia ou transformar isso num negócio chegam até nós todos os meses, por campanhas, site, Whats App e canais digitais. O CRM está rodando, o funil tem etapas reais, e a comissão é simples: você fecha, você ganha, aparece no holerite.

Boa parte da estrutura que um vendedor bom procura já está de pé. O que ainda está sendo construído, você ajuda a construir. O que falta nela é você.

REMUNERAÇÃ O E MODELO

Fixo competitivo + comissão por máquina vendida.

Ticket alto, campanhas rodando e leads inbound chegando até você. O lead é seu do primeiro contato ao fechamento, sem prospecção fria como rotina. Quanto você leva pra casa depende de quanto você fecha.

O QUE VOCÊ GANHA AQUI

• Comissão por máquina vendida. Ticket alto significa comissão que vale a pena.

• O lead é seu, de ponta a ponta. Leads inbound pré-qualificados, pagos pela empresa. Você não prospecta do zero nem caça contato frio como rotina. E não é só o "braço de fechamento" de um lead que outra pessoa preparou: você assume desde o primeiro contato e conduz até a venda. Em troca, a responsabilidade de conduzir, retomar e reativar cada lead é sua.

• Comercial estruturado de verdade. CRM rodando, pipeline com etapas claras e números à mão. Experiência prática com Hub Spot, Salesforce, Pipedrive ou similares é diferencial; o que importa é você trabalhar com método, não no improviso.

• Domínio técnico por nossa conta. Você já sabe vender; nós te treinamos no produto. Não precisa chegar sabendo de máquina.

• Espaço pra crescer. A operação está em estruturação. Quem entra agora e performa ajuda a construir o time e cresce junto com ele.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI VENDER (E PRA QUEM)

Os leads chegam pré-qualificados, e é aí que muita gente se engana: lead com interesse não é lead decidido.

Nosso cliente, muitas vezes, é uma pessoa física tomando uma decisão de investimento, com cabeça de empreendedor, mas sem a maturidade de um empresário experiente. Ele não está comprando uma ferramenta simples. Está decidindo se vai começar um negócio, construir a própria casa ou colocar as economias numa produção. Tem desejo real, mas também tem medo, família opinando e receio de comprar a máquina errada.

Aqui a venda não fecha numa ligação. O ciclo médio leva semanas e vários pontos de contato. É venda técnica e consultiva, não call de fechamento rápido com gatilho de urgência.

Seu papel é conduzir essa decisão até um "sim" seguro, com clareza, paciência e firmeza, ajudando a pessoa a comprar a máquina certa, não a mais cara.

Se venda consultiva, pipeline e taxa de conversão fazem parte do seu vocabulário, você vai se sentir em casa. Aqui o vendedor é tratado como profissional de processo, não como tirador de pedido.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

• Assumir o lead desde o primeiro contato (Whats App, telefone e vídeo). Ele chega pré-qualificado, e você confirma rápido o encaixe antes de avançar.

• Conduzir esse lead por todas as etapas do pipeline, sabendo exatamente em que ponto da jornada ele está.

• Entender o objetivo real do cliente: momento, orçamento, estrutura e receios.

• Apresentar a solução certa (modelo de máquina, produção, suporte, garantia), construindo valor antes do preço.

• Conduzir proposta, negociação e follow-up com método e cadência.

• Registrar tudo no CRM e acompanhar seus próprios números de conversão.

VOCÊ É QUEM PROCURAMOS SE

• Já operou um pipeline com etapas e sabe ler em que ponto cada lead está.

• Trabalha com qualificação, cadência de follow-up e acompanhamento de números.

• Tem disciplina de CRM e enxerga isso como ferramenta, não burocracia.

• Gosta de venda consultiva, e não só de negociar preço.

• Lida bem com o cliente que pergunta, compara e tem receio de decidir.

• Conversa com naturalidade tanto com gente simples quanto com cliente mais estruturado.

• Quer ser dono do ciclo completo, do primeiro contato ao fechamento, e não só fechar o que já chega pronto na mão.

• Assume o resultado: quando a venda não fecha, olha pro próprio processo antes de culpar o lead.

Sua senioridade é em vendas. O produto a gente te ensina.

CONDIÇÕ ES

• Remuneração: fixo competitivo + comissão por máquina vendida.

• Modelo de trabalho: presencial em Pindamonhangaba. O time comercial trabalha junto, na mesma sala: troca de casos, ritmo de equipe e mentoria no dia a dia. É assim que vendedor bom fica melhor.

• Benefícios e contratação: Vale transporte

Vale Alimentação

Cesta Básica

Refeição na empresa

Day Off

Estacionamento para motos

Cesta de Natal

Gympass

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie seu currículo respondendo às perguntas abaixo para . Seja concreto: números e exemplos reais dizem mais do que o currículo sozinho.

1. Qual era seu ticket médio, ciclo médio (em dias) e meta mensal na sua última operação comercial?

2. Descreva o pipeline real que você usava: as etapas, o critério para um lead avançar de uma para outra, e em qual etapa você mais perdia venda.

3. Conte uma venda consultiva real: produto, valor, a objeção principal, quantos follow-ups levou e como você fechou.

4. Você já perdeu uma venda por falta de follow-up? O que mudou no seu método depois disso?

A Verde não procura um vendedor para tirar pedido. Procura alguém capaz de pegar um lead com interesse real, diagnosticar o perfil, construir segurança e conduzir uma decisão de investimento até o fim, vendendo a máquina certa, não a mais cara. Se é você, queremos te conhecer.

title: Operations lead
description:
About Perk Up

Perk Up is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242 B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit .

We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3 PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.

This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.

The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.

This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.

What you’ll own Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3 PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations. Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability. Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy. Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability. Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution. Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix. Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls. Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.

What success looks like Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably. Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors. Your direct report and 3 PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence. Perk Up’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.

What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes. Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams. Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required. Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams. Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output. A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure. Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth. Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.

Role details Location: Remote, Latin America Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time Engagement: Full-time contractor $4,500–$5,000 USD per month

Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as Perk Up scales.

title: Client success manager (smma)
description:
Client Success Manager — 2 URN Marketing

Location: Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: COO Comp: $2,000 + $ bonuses tied to retention & client results and revneu share (3% of renewals + 10% Upsells)

Read this part first

Most agencies hand a roofer a login and a monthly report and call it service. We don't do that. We come into roofing companies internally and build — the funnel, the CRM, the follow-up, the reporting, the process their office actually runs on. Our clients don't buy leads from us. They buy a lead engine we install and then operate alongside their team.

That means this is not a check-in-and-take-notes job. You are the person inside the client's business making the machine work. If you like owning outcomes and hate babysitting inboxes, keep reading.

What you'll actually own

You'll carry a book of roofing contractor accounts from signed contract through their entire life with us.

Launch (first 24–72 hours after a client signs)

Run the onboarding call and pull everything the build needs: service area, offer, pricing, photos, reviews, brand assets, calendar availability. Stand up their Go High Level sub-account: pipeline, calendar, lead-intake workflows, SMS + email follow-up, call routing. Get their landing page live and their form wired to the CRM — then test it yourself by submitting a real lead and watching it land. Confirm tracking fires end to end before a dollar of ad spend goes out.

We launch clients in days, not weeks. That deadline is yours to hold.

Ongoing (where the job really lives)

Watch every account's numbers daily: leads, cost per lead, show rate, booked inspections, closed jobs. Know which of your accounts is drifting before the client does. Run weekly and monthly client calls. Walk them through what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing — in plain English, not ad-platform jargon. Be the bridge to the media buyer and creative team. When CPL climbs or leads stop booking, you diagnose whether it's ads, the offer, the follow-up, or the client's own sales process — and you route it to the right person with the data attached. Coach the client's office staff on speed-to-lead and follow-up. Half of a bad month is a roofer who isn't calling leads back in five minutes. Your job is to say that out loud, kindly, with the call logs to prove it. Keep every account's notes, action items, and next steps current in the CRM and in Click Up. If it isn't written down, it didn't happen. Spot expansion honestly: more markets, more spend, add-on programs — but only when the core engine is already producing.

Retention

Own renewal and churn risk for your book. You should know which client is unhappy two weeks before they tell you. Run save conversations yourself. Bring the numbers, own what we got wrong, and come with a fix, not an apology.

What we measure you on

Client retention and length of stay On-time launches (live inside the promised window) Account health: leads delivered, CPL against target, show rate, booked jobs Speed of response to client issues CRM/Click Up hygiene — notes, action items, and reporting actually current

Who this is for

2+ years in account management, client success, or agency service — or you've run operations inside a home-services company and know the trade from inside. Comfortable in a CRM every single day. We run Go High Level — if you know it, say so loudly in your application. If you don't, you need to be the kind of person who'll learn a platform cold in two weeks. You can read an ad account report and tell a story with it. You don't need to be a media buyer, but you must know what cost per lead, show rate, and cost per booked job mean and what makes each one move. Direct communicator. Our clients are roofing owners and GMs. They want straight answers, not marketing vocabulary. Organized without being reminded. You'll juggle a dozen accounts, each with its own build state, spend level, and open items. Thick skin and a spine. Sometimes the honest answer is "your team isn't calling the leads." You have to be able to say it.

Bonus points for: home services / roofing / construction background, Meta Ads Manager familiarity, funnel building, Click Up, experience owning a renewal number.

What you get

A real book of business and the authority to actually fix things, not just escalate them. Direct access to the founder and the build team — no layers. A company that already has the delivery figured out: 26+ roofing clients served and 14,676 leads generated to date, backed by a 100,000-dollars-in- signed-jobs-in-90-days guarantee. You're not selling a promise; you're operating something that works. Unlimited PTO / Learning Oppertunities

title: International bookkeeper & finance specialist (remote - brazil)
description:
Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Reports To: CRO / Founder

Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)

We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).

2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices ( Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e ) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.

3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).

4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.

Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais , basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.

What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Bombeiro(a) para atuar no time de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Atuar nas emergências conforme os procedimentos operacionais padrão de cada cenário emergencial;

Organizar, capacitar e coordenar as brigadas industriais e agrícolas;

Conduzir veículos de emergência (ambulância e caminhão pipa);

Programar e executar teste, inspeção, ensaio, limpeza, substituição e/ou reposição de equipamentos, veículos, sistemas de proteção de combate a incêndio e de atendimento as emergências;

Treinar os brigadistas em combate a incêndio, vazamentos de produtos químicos, primeiros socorros e outros;

Registrar as intervenções, elaborar relatórios de simulados, intercorrências e atas de turno;

Organizar, conduzir e ou coordenar simulado de emergências conforme os cenários de riscos mapeados.

Quais os requisitos?

Curso de bombeiro profissional civil (vigente);

CNH C ou D;

Curso de transporte de veículos de emergência (vigente);

Pacote Office;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Auditor - barra da tijuca/rj
description:
A White Martins é a maior empresa de gases industriais e medicinais da América Latina. Subsidiária da Linde plc, ela é sede do grupo para sete países do continente que abrangem mais de 5 mil colaboradores. Em âmbito global, o grupo reúne cerca de 80 mil funcionários e está presente em mais de 100 países.

Sua Linha de Produtos e serviços é das mais completas do mercado: inclui gases atmosféricos (oxigênio, nitrogênio e argônio), gases de processo (gás carbônico, acetileno, hidrogênio e misturas para soldagem), carbureto de cálcio, além de gases especiais e medicinais.

Em linha com sua missão de construir um mundo mais produtivo, a empresa aprimora o desempenho econômico e ambiental de seus clientes e opera em setores que são pilares da economia nacional: alimentos e bebidas, gás natural, meio ambiente, metal-mecânico, segmentos de pequeno consumo, mineração e siderurgia. Além disso, atua fortemente na área da saúde por meio do fornecimento de gases medicinais e de equipamentos médico-hospitalar.

Siga conosco e confira nossas soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.

title: Online business english teacher
description:
About the job

Company Description C-Leader English Academy helps professionals and executives develop the business English they need to perform in real-world corporate situations. The academy offers highly personalized programs tailored to each learner’s professional context, goals, and communication challenges, avoiding generic classes and focusing on efficiency. Its method combines realistic business scenarios, strategic communication practice, and direct application to daily work routines. This approach builds confidence, clarity, and measurable impact in the workplace. C-Leader is ideal for those seeking structured, purposeful, and fast-paced language development that supports leadership and global positioning.

Role Description

The Online Business English Teacher will deliver high-quality business-focused English lessons to professionals and executives, using C-Leader’s personalized methodology. Day-to-day tasks include preparing tailored lesson plans based on learners’ industries and roles, conducting live online classes, and focusing on communication skills for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership contexts. The teacher will assess learner progress, provide detailed feedback, and adjust content to address evolving communication needs and business scenarios. Responsibilities also include maintaining accurate records of sessions, collaborating with the academic team to refine materials, and ensuring a consistent, professional learning experience. This is an online work position, and is open only to non-Brazilian candidates.

-ACTIVE CNPJ is essential and mandatory

-FLUENT ENGLISH at teaching level with excellent grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation suitable for business environments.

-International TEACHING CERTIFICATION or graduation in Education, Languages, Linguistics, Business, or a related field; international teaching certificates (e.g., CELTA, TESOL).

-Proven solid EXPERIENCE teaching English to professionals or executives, with a focus on business or corporate communication.

-Proven experience with ONLINE TEACHING

-Ability to design and deliver personalized lesson plans based on learners’ job roles, industries, and real business situations.

-Skills in facilitating communication practice for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership interactions.

-Comfort with online teaching tools, learning platforms, and digital resources to support interactive and engaging classes.

-Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to work with diverse, high-level professionals in a respectful, inclusive manner.

-Know how to use Google Meet and Notion for teaching

-Having a good computer setup and a stable internet connection

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
About First Ignite

First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Ai operations
description:
About Liora

Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay.

Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget.

What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight.

The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved.

We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors.

This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents.

We are looking for the person who will make it work.

What you'll operate

Credit & Risk

Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client.

Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you.

Ownership Transfer

Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems.

Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle.

These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command.

Who you are

We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems.

You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one.

Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it.

You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer.

You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again.

Why now, why Liora

The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers.

We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end.

You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go.

The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Estamos buscando uma pessoa analítica e com visão estratégica para fazer parte da nossa equipe Contábil. Esta pessoa será responsável por conduzir o ciclo contábil completo, do fechamento às demonstrações financeiras, garantindo acuracidade, conformidade com CPC/IFRS e entregando análises que conectam o contábil ao operacional e ao estratégico.

Principais Responsabilidades

- Produzir análises de resultado e variações mensais com explicações gerenciais claras, conectando o contábil ao operacional e ao estratégico

- Executar conciliações contábeis e análises críticas de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, identificando inconsistências proativamente

- Conduzir o ciclo completo do ativo imobilizado: controle, depreciação, baixas e conciliação

- Conduzir processos de consolidação contábil do grupo, incluindo eliminações intercompany e padronização de práticas entre entidades

- Aplicar e controlar o método de equivalência patrimonial, reconhecendo resultados, variações patrimoniais e impactos no patrimônio líquido

- Garantir aderência plena às normas CPC/IFRS e à legislação societária vigente

- Atuar como interface técnica com auditoria externa e interna, conduzindo testes, revisões e esclarecimentos com autonomia

- Contribuir para a evolução de processos, controles internos e políticas contábeis, propondo e implementando soluções

- Apoiar a liderança da Controladoria em análises estratégicas, relatórios gerenciais e projetos de melhoria estrutural

- Vivência prática em fechamento contábil, elaboração e revisão de demonstrações financeiras, consolidação e equivalência patrimonial.

- Conhecimento aplicado das normas CPC/IFRS

- Experiência direta com auditoria externa.

- Excel avançado.

- Domínio em ERP contábil (SAP, Protheus, Oracle, Sankhya ou similares)

- Experiência em empresas de Meios de Pagamento.

Requisitos Desejáveis

- Experiência em grupos empresariais, holdings ou estruturas com múltiplas entidades jurídicas

- Participação em projetos de reorganização societária, implantação ou melhoria de ERP, ou fast close

- Pós-graduação ou especialização em Contabilidade, Controladoria ou Finanças.

- Vivência com automação de processos contábeis, Power Query, Power BI ou ferramentas de dados aplicadas à contabilidade.

title: Country manager
description:
Position Description

1. Market Growth & Business Ownership

Own business growth and key market performance for the region, with clear accountability for business outcomes and growth metrics. Analyze market performance, user behavior, and competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities and provide strategic insights to global teams.

2. User Growth & Market Development

Build the local market from 0 to 1 by developing scalable user acquisition and growth programs. Drive organic user acquisition through localized social media, KOLs, creator programs, online communities, partnerships, and other community-led initiatives. Increase Tripo's local presence, ecosystem penetration, and user touchpoints across both online and offline channels.

3. Creator Ecosystem & Community

Recruit, engage, and retain creators, studios, agencies, and other ecosystem partners. Design creator programs, incentive systems, and community initiatives that strengthen long-term engagement and ecosystem growth. Develop a deep understanding of creator workflows and translate creator feedback into product improvements and business opportunities.

4. Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

Build strategic relationships with KOLs, creator communities, educational institutions, media, industry organizations, and ecosystem partners. Expand Tripo's presence within the local creative, AI, and 3 D ecosystem through long-term partnerships. Identify partnership opportunities that accelerate user growth and long-term ecosystem development.

5. Localization & Brand Presence

Localize messaging, campaigns, and content to better resonate with local creators and users. Manage regional social channels and collaborate with the global marketing team on localized campaigns and paid creative assets. Represent Tripo at conferences, workshops, meetups, creator events, and other industry activities

6. Cross-functional Leadership

Serve as the bridge between local users and global Product, Marketing, Growth, and Operations teams. Deliver structured market reporting and recommendations to help shape product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

Qualifications 3+ years of experience in market operations, growth, business development, community, or ecosystem development, preferably in AI, Saa S, gaming, 3 D, developer tools, or the creator economy. Strong ownership mindset with accountability for business performance and measurable market growth. Proven experience building markets from 0 to 1 and driving user growth through social media, KOLs, creator communities, partnerships, and other organic growth channels. Deep understanding of local markets, creator ecosystems, and community operations. Good understanding of both consumer (B2 C) growth and small business (SMB) customer acquisition and engagement. Data-driven, strategic, and capable of turning insights into actionable business initiatives. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; bilingual or multilingual candidates are preferred. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and comfortable operating in ambiguity—from strategy to execution, from growth initiatives to event logistics.

benefit of client and industry.

title: Especialista em pcp / manufatura - totvs protheus
description:
VAGA: ESPECIALISTA EM PCP / MANUFATURA – TOTVS PROTHEUS

Estamos buscando um profissional Pleno ou Sênior, com sólida experiência em TOTVS Protheus , para atuar com PCP, manufatura, implantação, parametrização, sustentação e atendimento consultivo a clientes .

Buscamos um profissional que tenha forte domínio dos processos de planejamento e controle da produção dentro do Protheus , sendo capaz de analisar cenários, identificar inconsistências, realizar parametrizações e propor soluções funcionais para os desafios dos clientes.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Presencial: 2 dias por semana

Atuação: Suporte, implantação, sustentação e consultoria em clientes

FOCO DA VAGA

O principal foco desta posição será atuar nos módulos de Manufatura do TOTVS Protheus , especialmente:

SIGAPCP – PCP / Planejamento e Controle da Produção

SIGAEST – Estoque / Custos

SIGADPR – Desenvolvimento de Produtos

SIGAQIE – Inspeção de Entrada / Qualidade

Buscamos um profissional com capacidade de compreender todo o fluxo produtivo , desde a estruturação do produto e seus componentes, passando pelo planejamento e execução da produção, movimentação dos estoques e controles relacionados à qualidade.

O profissional deverá atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o processo do cliente, identificando a causa dos problemas e propondo a melhor solução dentro do ecossistema TOTVS Protheus .

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Atuar como referência funcional nos processos de PCP e Manufatura do Protheus ; Implantar, parametrizar e sustentar processos relacionados ao SIGAPCP ; Analisar e solucionar chamados de média e alta complexidade relacionados aos processos produtivos; Analisar cenários de planejamento e controle da produção ; Atuar com processos de MRP e necessidades de materiais ; Analisar e parametrizar Ordens de Produção ; Analisar estruturas, componentes e informações utilizadas no processo produtivo; Avaliar impactos das movimentações de produção nos estoques e custos ; Apoiar processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e manutenção de produtos; Analisar processos de inspeção e qualidade relacionados ao recebimento de materiais; Identificar inconsistências entre os processos de negócio e a parametrização do Protheus; Realizar levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções funcionais; Apoiar projetos de implantação, melhorias e evolução do ERP; Participar de testes, homologações e validações junto aos usuários; Elaborar documentação funcional e apoiar a capacitação dos usuários; Interagir com equipes técnicas/desenvolvimento para especificação de customizações e correções; Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos clientes, propondo melhorias nos processos de manufatura.

REQUISITOS – CONHECIMENTOS EM PROTHEUS

SIGAPCP – PCP / MANUFATURA

Domínio funcional do SIGAPCP , incluindo conhecimentos em: Planejamento e Controle da Produção; MRP – Material Requirements Planning; Ordens de Produção; Necessidades de produção; Planejamento de materiais; Estrutura de produtos e componentes; Roteiros e processos produtivos; Apontamentos de produção; Consumo de materiais; Movimentações relacionadas à produção; Encerramento de Ordens de Produção; Parametrizações do módulo; Análise de inconsistências nos processos produtivos; Integrações do PCP com estoque, produtos e custos.

SIGAEST – ESTOQUE / CUSTOS

Conhecimento dos processos de:

Gestão de estoques; Movimentação de materiais; Entradas e saídas de estoque; Consumo de matérias-primas; Movimentações provenientes da produção; Saldos e custos; Formação e análise de custos; Integração entre estoque, produção e custos; Impactos das movimentações do PCP nos estoques.

SIGADPR – DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PRODUTOS

Conhecimento funcional dos processos relacionados a:

Cadastro e manutenção de produtos; Estrutura de produtos / BOM; Componentes; Revisões e alterações de produtos; Informações utilizadas pelo processo produtivo; Integração entre desenvolvimento de produtos e PCP.

SIGAQIE – INSPEÇÃO DE ENTRADA / QUALIDADE

Conhecimento dos processos relacionados a:

Inspeção de entrada; Controle de qualidade de materiais recebidos; Processos de inspeção; Aprovação e reprovação de materiais; Integração entre qualidade, estoque e demais processos do ERP.

⭐ DIFERENCIAIS

Será considerado um diferencial possuir conhecimento em outros módulos e processos integrados ao ambiente de manufatura do Protheus, principalmente:

SIGACOM – Compras

SIGAFAT – Faturamento

SIGAFIS – Fiscal

SIGACTB – Contábil

SIGAFIN – Financeiro

Conhecimento de ADVPL e capacidade de interpretar customizações existentes;

Experiência em projetos de implantação ou roll-out do TOTVS Protheus ;

Experiência em ambientes industriais e processos de manufatura;

Experiência em levantamento e especificação de requisitos funcionais;

Conhecimento de integrações entre os módulos de manufatura do Protheus.

Não é necessário dominar todos os módulos do Protheus. O principal requisito é possuir forte experiência em PCP/Manufatura, especialmente no SIGAPCP, com conhecimento dos processos integrados de estoque, custos, produtos e qualidade.

SOBRE A SENIORIDADE

A vaga está aberta para profissionais de nível PLENO ou SÊNIOR .

Buscamos principalmente profissionais que já tenham atuado na prática com TOTVS Protheus em ambientes de manufatura , seja em consultoria, implantação, sustentação ou dentro de empresas industriais.

Profissionais com perfil Sênior e experiência diferenciada em SIGAPCP e processos de manufatura também serão avaliados.

Para profissionais com maior senioridade e experiência compatível com a posição, poderemos avaliar uma negociação diferenciada de acordo com o perfil apresentado .

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Procuramos alguém que vá além de simplesmente conhecer as telas do Protheus.

Queremos um profissional que consiga:

Entender o processo industrial → identificar o problema → analisar o Protheus → encontrar a causa → propor a solução → parametrizar/testar → acompanhar a entrega.

Se você possui experiência sólida em PCP/Manufatura no TOTVS Protheus e gosta de atuar de forma consultiva na solução de problemas e evolução dos processos dos clientes, queremos conhecer você.

Envie seu currículo para participar do nosso processo seletivo.

title: Head de operações
description:
Missão

Liderar e desenvolver a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito de operações financeiras agrícolas, assegurando excelência na execução, segurança jurídica, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e geração de resultados.

Será responsável por estruturar uma operação altamente padronizada, auditável e orientada por dados, capaz de conduzir toda a jornada de recuperação de crédito — desde a cobrança preventiva e extrajudicial até a preparação dos casos para judicialização — preservando a exigibilidade dos créditos, a qualidade das evidências e a efetividade das estratégias adotadas.

Atuará como principal elo entre Operações, Jurídico, Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio, transformando desafios operacionais em processos, controles, automações e soluções tecnológicas. Buscamos uma liderança com forte capacidade de execução, profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para construir uma operação escalável por meio de dados, tecnologia, inteligência artificial e melhoria contínua.

Principais Responsabilidades Liderar a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito, garantindo produtividade, qualidade, segurança jurídica e cumprimento dos prazos; Definir a estratégia operacional das carteiras, considerando exposição financeira, estágio da inadimplência, perfil do devedor, garantias disponíveis e expectativa de recuperação; Governar toda a jornada de recuperação, incluindo notificações, negociações, promessas de pagamento, acordos, protestos, negativação, baixas, gestão de garantias e preparação para judicialização; Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar políticas, fluxos, procedimentos, critérios de priorização, níveis de alçada e controles internos; Assegurar a rastreabilidade das ações de cobrança e a adequada formalização de contatos, propostas, acordos, pagamentos, garantias e demais evidências; Garantir, em parceria com o Jurídico, que os casos encaminhados à judicialização estejam completos, fundamentados e documentalmente preparados, preservando a exigibilidade do crédito; Liderar, desenvolver e dimensionar a equipe de acordo com o volume, a complexidade e as prioridades das carteiras, atuando também como referência técnica em casos críticos; Definir e acompanhar indicadores de recuperação, produtividade, aging, acordos, promessas de pagamento, SLAs, custos e qualidade operacional; Conduzir comitês de cobrança e elaborar análises executivas sobre resultados, riscos, estratégias adotadas e oportunidades de recuperação; Identificar oportunidades de automação e ganho de escala, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em requisitos para Produto, Engenharia e fornecedores de tecnologia; Aplicar dados e inteligência artificial na segmentação de carteiras, priorização de casos, recomendação de estratégias e controle da qualidade operacional; Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, fundos, cedentes, escritórios jurídicos e parceiros especializados, assegurando alinhamento sobre estratégias, prazos e resultados.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações de cobrança extrajudicial e recuperação de crédito; Vivência na gestão de carteiras inadimplentes de média ou alta complexidade; Conhecimento aprofundado dos fluxos de cobrança, negociação, protesto, negativação, acordos, garantias e preparação para judicialização; Experiência na estruturação, revisão e melhoria de processos operacionais; Histórico de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance; Experiência com indicadores, metas, SLAs e gestão orientada por dados; Capacidade de análise de carteiras, definição de prioridades e construção de estratégias de recuperação; Experiência em projetos de automação, implantação de sistemas ou transformação digital; Boa interlocução com áreas Jurídica, Financeira, Produto e Engenharia; Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica e, simultaneamente, acompanhar a execução operacional em profundidade.

Requisitos Desejáveis Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio; Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito; Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas; Familiaridade com CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais; Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados; Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança; Vivência com Legal Ops, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras; Pós-graduação em Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.

Competências Esperadas Liderança com forte orientação para execução; Visão estratégica e pensamento sistêmico; Capacidade de tomar decisões em ambientes de pressão e incerteza; Profundidade analítica e domínio de indicadores; Excelente capacidade de negociação; Comunicação clara, firme e executiva; Disciplina de processos e atenção à qualidade; Senso de urgência e capacidade de priorização; Protagonismo, autonomia e responsabilidade; Capacidade de construir soluções em ambientes em desenvolvimento; Facilidade para transitar entre negócio, jurídico, operação e tecnologia; Orientação para resultado sem comprometer governança e segurança jurídica.

Principais Indicadores de Sucesso Aumento da taxa e do valor de recuperação das carteiras; Redução do tempo médio de tratamento e recuperação; Aumento da conversão de acordos e promessas de pagamento; Cumprimento dos SLAs operacionais; Redução de falhas documentais e operacionais; Qualidade e completude dos casos encaminhados à judicialização; Evolução da produtividade e da capacidade operacional; Maior previsibilidade sobre resultados, riscos e expectativa de recuperação; Implantação de automações e ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência; Satisfação dos clientes e stakeholders com a gestão das carteiras.

O que temos por aqui: Trabalho remoto (encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos/SP) Remuneração compatível (PJ) Benefício flexível via cartão Swile Wellhub (antigo Gympass) Convênio médico Porto Saúde Convênio odontológico Uniodonto

title: Barbeiro
description:

A Brum Visagismo & Estilo é o primeiro centro de visagismo e imagem masculina de campinas dedicado a oferecer atenção técnica e personalização ao público masculino, cada corte barba e recomendação de estilo é baseada em análise científica do formato de rosto proporções faciais e arquétipo pessoal de cada cliente.
